decisive_spans.text: Histopathology:    Image Title: Hematoxylin-eosin staining (×40 and ×200)    Image Description: Revealed endometrial glands consisting of a single layer of monomorphous cuboidal cells with an endometrial stroma

response.rationale: D8 is directly supported by the histopathology findings of endometrial-like features. D5 is a general diagnosis for a subcutaneous nodule but lacks the specific histopathological support present for D8.
